requirement: The database refuses to edit, add to or delete a published place snapshot and its parts; only published to superseded, a source's scheduling facts and a page named for the next run (nothing collected) move

oracle.ref: PR #1686 (fix); fix evidence: wo_place_snapshot and its four child tables had no trigger, unlike wo_place_media and wo_social_snapshot
oracle.invariant: S1: every write is refused with 'place snapshot guard'. S2: every write succeeds; superseded cannot go back to published or be deleted. S3: verifyWoSchema reports no difference and the marker rows name the adopted files.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
productSourcesUnresolved: apps/tracy-web/src/db/index.js:52 readFile() with a computed path

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a snapshot being prepared is the run's own
published content cannot be edited, added to, or deleted
a published snapshot may name a page for the next run, but never what was collected
after publication only the lifecycle and the sources' scheduling facts move
an import or backfill writes a published snapshot and its parts in one transaction
a snapshot that never published can be failed or set aside
Tracy's full chain reaches the target
a host that does not declare the guard it carries is refused adoption
a database adopted at the baseline alone gets the guard from the package
Tracy's copy of each package file it carries is the same SQL
